full_judgment: Nazmun Ara Sultana J. This Civil petition for Leave to Appeal at the instance of ICB Islamic Bank Limited (previously Al-Baraka Bank, Bangladesh Limited), is directed against the judgment and order dated the 22.11.2009 passed by the High Court Division in First Appeal No.77 of 1995 dismissing the appeal and thereby affirming the judgment and decree dated 09.02.1995 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat No.3, Dhaka in Money suit No.248 of 1991 dismissing the same.
